title: Gravity gets the last shot
brief: This is the stronger selection after comparing five recorded games. The orange archer releases an arrow toward the black opponent on a floating platform, the arrow hits, and the opponent falls off the ledge before a real Victory/+90/three-star panel appears. Do not invent multiplayer trolling, revenge, a flawless win, or opponent intent; orange already has 90 health. Build the comic story around the unsafe ledge and fall, close to the reference grammar of setup then an opponent suffering an absurd physical consequence. Source is short: an honest 5–7 second edit is preferable to padding to the style's nominal duration. Slow only the brief action/anticipation if useful; freeze a real tumbling moment, reaction face in open sky, then show the full fall and actual result. Leave the central Victory panel clear. Keep arrow flight and impact visible.
